YOUR LEDGER-INTEGRITY FINDING = CONFIRMED REAL, FIXED, AND NOW TESTED.
You were right that an entry's mere PRESENCE was treated as authority. fixed_sleeve_entry_valid
now requires a well-formed AND side-consistent entry: non-empty slices must be positive, finite
and come with side +/-1; empty slices are authority ONLY with side 0. Everything else FAILS CLOSED
(no key -> FIXED_MODE_AUTHORITY_HOLD), and a corrupt ledger is never silently reset. Proven by
NEG_LEDGER_EMPTY_SLICES_NONZERO_SIDE_FAILS_CLOSED, NEG_LEDGER_NONEMPTY_SLICES_ZERO_SIDE_FAILS_CLOSED,
NEG_LEDGER_NEGATIVE_SLICE_FAILS_CLOSED, NEG_LEDGER_NAN_SLICE_FAILS_CLOSED,
NEG_LEDGER_NONNUMERIC_SLICE_FAILS_CLOSED, plus POS_LEDGER_LEGITIMATE_CLOSE_RELEASES_AT_ZERO (a genuine
close must still release at zero so the follower can flatten - failing that closed would strand it).

A. INTAKE-LEVEL PROOFS (test_g4_intake_sleeves.py, real process_fill, not apply_leader_event):
   A_DUPLICATE_INTAKE_MINTS_ONCE (duplicate WS fragment mints nothing)
   A_DISTINCT_INCREASE_ADDS_ONE_SLICE
   A_RESTART_AND_REPLAY_MINT_NOTHING (persist + reload + replay)
   A_FIXED_EVENTS_ISOLATED_FROM_OTHER_WALLET (other sleeve and inventory untouched)
B. UI CONTROL PROOFS (test_g4_ui_controls.py, in-process TestClient, no LIVE order):
   B_SET_WALLET_MODE_EXECUTES_AND_PERSISTS; B_UI_OFF_AFFECTS_ENGINE_TRUTH (fills_skipped_off, zero
   position); B_UI_CLOSE_ONLY_BLOCKS_NEW_ENTRIES (fills_skipped_clo_entry); B_UNKNOWN_MODE_FAILS_CLOSED
   (EMERGENCY_STOP/PAUSED -> 400 BAD_MODE, gate unchanged); B_USER_WALLET_NEVER_ENABLES (forced OFF);
   B_RESET_SAFE_DOES_NOT_TOUCH_ENGINE_TRUTH; B_SNAPSHOT_GRANTS_NO_AUTHORITY.
   This required a MINIMAL compatibility bridge: the engine now reads the restored UI's wallet_gate.json
   (HL_LIVE_WALLET_GATE_FILE, else AUDIT_DIR/wallet_gate.json). It is READ-ONLY and MONOTONE - it can
   only reduce authority (OFF -> existing OFF path, CLOSE_ONLY -> existing CLO entry-block path); ON,
   absent or malformed -> unchanged; every failure is a no-op. The UI file itself is untouched.
C. MARK AUTHORITY - DISCLOSURE, NOT A CLAIM. Slice price resolves mark_price -> limit_price -> fill.price,
   and fill.price is the engine's canonical event price (the same value the planner already uses as
   mark_px in convergence_order_for_coin). Missing/zero mark mints ZERO authority
   (NEG_MISSING_MARK_MINTS_ZERO). There is NO independent freshness/staleness check, because the engine
   has no fresher mark source than the event it just received - I will not claim otherwise. If you want
   a hard freshness bound, name the authoritative mark source and I will implement it fail-closed.
D. PLANNER TRUTH: D_FIXED_OPEN_PLANS_ATTRIBUTED_SLEEVE, D_FIXED_REDUCE_FOLLOWS_SLEEVE_FRACTION,
   D_FIXED_CLOSE_FLATTENS_TO_ZERO (all through the real desired-net -> planner path), D_SINGLE_EXCHANGE_ORDER_SITE,
   plus G3's unrelated-inventory-preserved checks. Note: a sub-minimum reducible notional is correctly
   REFUSED by the exchange minimum rather than forced - that is engine behaviour, not a sleeve defect.

STILL OPEN FROM MY PREVIOUS RESULT (unchanged): G2 t4's locked check encoded the pre-ruling
"fixed mode always holds" invariant, which ruling b35be5e9 supersedes. I updated that single check to
the ruled semantics, annotated SUPERSEDED-LOCKED-CHECK. Ratify or direct a revert.
